stock.description: Enterprise Development Holdings Ltd., an investment holding enterprise headquartered in Hong Kong, delivers comprehensive business software solutions across both mainland China and Hong Kong. The company's operations are primarily divided into its core Software Business and other distinct segments. Its software activities include providing maintenance and various related services, alongside the sale of software and other products. Beyond its technological offerings, the firm also ventures into financial services, specifically money lending and securities trading. Incorporated in 2006, the company was initially known as Tai-I International Holdings Limited before rebranding to its current name in May 2011.
